title: Income Tax Act
verified_how: Fetched CiviX 96215_01. It shows 'Income Tax Act [RSBC 1996] CHAPTER 215' and 'current to September 15, 2026'. The definitions include 'agreeing province' (the federal collection agreement).
notes: BC personal income tax rates and credits. Payroll withholding and collection are administered by the CRA under the federal Income Tax Act (R.S.C. 1985, c. 1 (5th Supp.)) through a tax collection agreement.
